final: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT COALESCE(s.riskeval, 'No Status') as riskeval_status, AVG(CAST(sc.gbsize AS REAL) / CAST(sc.spanmin AS REAL)) as avg_rate FROM scans sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(s.riskeval, 'No Status')), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as bench_rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(gr.avg_rate) as average_rate, AVG(gr.avg_rate - b.bench_rate) as average_margin_above_benchmark FROM group_rates gr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE gr.avg_rate > b.bench_rate
